National Manager, Brand Communications
BMW Canada

Andrea Lopez
Head of Mx Development 
Havas Media

Matt Burgess
VP Revenue Operations
Freestar

These efforts have shown to be fruitful in the expansion of our partnership."

                

                  

                  

                    
Patrick McCann
SVP Research
CafeMedia

                  

                

              

              

                
"Sharethrough has become a trusted partner to Bidtellect through their willingness to collaborate, their transparency, and by being attentive to our needs and the needs of our clients. Our partnership has enabled us to build a scalable and sustainable long-standing relationship. We are proud to be able to say that together we have contributed to building a better advertising ecosystem for all."

                

                  

                  

                    
Craig Aron
SVP Growth & Strategic Business Development
Bidtellect

We are constantly strengthening our partnership and not only a client-service provider relationship. We feel that everyone truly has our campaigns’ performance and overall digital business growth at heart. Their constant desire to innovate and improve makes them key players in the industry and our digital media mix."

                

                  

                  

                    
Veronique Hebert-Dumont
‍Manager, Consumer Growth & Engagement
Air Canada Vacations

Caroline Gamble
Media Specialist
Amnet Programmatic Experts
